pick.headline: Jonathan Pollard sentenced to life for spying for Israel
pick.summary: On 4 March 1987 former US Navy intelligence analyst Jonathan Pollard was sentenced to life in prison for passing classified documents to Israel.
pick.significance: The case was a rare espionage scandal involving a close US ally and strained US-Israeli relations for decades.

alternates.headline: Mugabe wins Zimbabwe election
alternates.summary: On 4 March 1980 Robert Mugabe's ZANU-PF was declared winner of the elections that ended white minority rule in Rhodesia.
alternates.significance: Zimbabwe became independent in April under Mugabe, who ruled until 2017.

alternates.headline: Reagan accepts responsibility for Iran arms deals
alternates.summary: On 4 March 1987 President Reagan said in a televised address that what began as a strategic opening to Iran had deteriorated into trading arms for hostages.
alternates.significance: The speech responded to the Tower Commission's criticism of the covert Iran-Contra operations run from the National Security Council.
